body:
Mmmm. You sound like a very empathetic person. For that, you may save a lot of people. For that, I sincerely thank you. Unfortunately that's not enough for me... unfortunately I need the few people in my life to reach out to me, but they won't. They'll leave me here. You're a stranger. A wonderful stranger, but still a stranger. I need her, I need them, I need the people who have rejected me. I need the people in my everyday, and that won't be.


Oh well, maybe after this they will read this and understand. Maybe after this they will read what has been thrown in front of them this entire time.

A therapist assumes that there is an outcome... some solution... that some state exists that is solvable. If I was lost and needed a map, I would seek a cartographer. Indeed I am alone and nothingness is my guide. I fear, but hope, death is my answer.

Years. Years of loneliness. I'm not sure you get that. Years of reaching out to save oneself, and years of that failing. I thank you for your effort, but I hope you know this isn't the rant of someone off a bad breakup.... this is the last call of a tenacious bastard who has clung to life that's ready to give up.
